definitions.gloss: kitchen sink; sink unit with a counter and basin
definitions.explanation: The sink area in a kitchen, including the basin, drainboard, and surrounding counter space. In modern Japanese kitchens, this typically refers to the entire sink unit built into the counter.

examples.japanese: {流|なが}し{台|だい}を{磨|みが}く。
{食器|しょっき}を{流|なが}し{台|だい}に{置|お}いてください。
examples.english: Please put the dishes in the sink.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}のキッチンは{流|なが}し{台|だい}が{広|ひろ}くて{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: The kitchen in the new place has a spacious sink area, which is easy to use.

notes:
Refers to the kitchen sink unit including the basin and surrounding counter. Composed of {流|なが}し (the act of washing/rinsing) + {台|だい} (counter/stand). In everyday speech, many people shorten this to just {流|なが}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流|なが}し{台|だい}を{掃除|そうじ}する: to clean the sink
- {流|なが}し{台|だい}の{排水口|はいすいこう}: the sink drain
- ステンレスの{流|なが}し{台|だい}: stainless steel sink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {流|なが}し: sink — shorter, more casual form; also used alone
- シンク: sink — loanword from English, common in modern kitchens
- {洗面台|せんめんだい}: washbasin — specifically the bathroom sink for face washing
